name: 阻塞唤醒过程

monitorQueues.flow: Entry Set → 抢到锁 → Owner → wait() → Wait Set → notify() → 回到Entry Set重新竞争

content.whyWaitInSync: wait需释放锁，必须先持有Monitor；否则IllegalMonitorStateException。notify同理

sleepVsWait.recover: wait等notify/超时, sleep时间到自动

threadCreation: extends Thread(不推荐,单继承限制)
implements Runnable(推荐,任务与线程分离)
implements Callable(有返回值+可抛异常)
content.startVsRun: start()=新建线程异步执行, run()=当前线程同步调用

notes: Monitor三队列: Entry Set(BLOCKED)→Owner→Wait Set(WAITING)→notify→回Entry Set竞争锁; wait必须synchronized
